product_metadata.title: Sweet Alice Salt and Pepper Grinder with Ceramic Rotor, Refillable Acrylic Pepper Mill Set, Easy to Adjust the Coarseness- 6 inches (brown)
features: CERAMIC GRINDER: Our grind mechanism is made from quality and durable ceramic, We believe a ceramic rotor is necessary to grind salt as the salt will corrode the metal rotor and cause rust and breakdown.

EASILY ADJUSTABLE: You can adjust the size of the salt and pepper just by turning the top knobe. Not only does it produce a grind perfect for the dinner table or for cooking, you don't have to flip it upside down to dispense the salt.

LARGE CAPACITY: The size of the salt grinder is 6 inches tall and 2.34 inches wide. These are a perfect size for folks who cook. Not too large to keep out for meals and not too small that they have to be refilled constantly.

MODERN AND UNIQUE STYLE: The grip is fine and the neck of the pepper mill narrows in giving the shape a more modern look. And the clear acrylic allows you to see when you need to think about refilling them soon.

100% QUALITY& MONEY BACK GUARANTEE: 100 days free replacement& money back if any dissatisfaction. We support our own branded products and provide excellent after-sales service for each customer. Your complete satisfaction is our top priority.
